name: Tenjo (Colombia)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tenjo (a sword on red and wheat on green beneath a yellow chief, with the motto DIGNIDAD, TRABAJO, LIBERTAD).
history: Municipal flag of Tenjo, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Tenjo arms — sword on red and wheat on green beneath a yellow chief, with motto DIGNIDAD, TRABAJO, LIBERTAD
